text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in mild pullback territory, with Ether underperforming BTC by about 130 basis points over the last day, suggesting some rotation away from altcoins. The Fear & Greed index at 27 signals genuine caution, though the recent 4-point uptick indicates buyers are testing lower levels rather than capitulating. At $66B in daily volume and BTC dominance holding above 56%, the market is contracting modestly but showing structural stability without panic liquidations.
